propositions: Developers must manually run multiple commands (git fetch, git worktree add, python venv creation, make install) to set up a fresh worktree with venv, which is error-prone and easy to shortcut.
A single `make worktree name=<branch>` target should automate the full worktree+venv bootstrap in one command, matching repo Makefile idiom and canonical install path.
The worktree target must require a name= argument, create the worktree at ../<name> branched from origin/main, provision venv with python3 -m venv and make install, and print activation instructions.
The worktree target must be discoverable via `make help`, listed in .PHONY, and documented in docs/local-dev-env.md as the one-command alternative to manual setup steps.
